info.name: FMCG DMS - Product Master & Price Master API
info.description:
Enterprise FMCG Distributor Management System - Complete API Collection

## Authentication
Most endpoints require JWT Bearer token in Authorization header.
All endpoints require `x-organization-id` header for multi-tenant isolation.

## Workflow
After login, set:
- `authToken` variable from login response.accessToken
- `orgId` variable from user's organizationId

## Collection Variables
- `baseUrl`: http://localhost:3001
- `authToken`: JWT access token (set after login)
- `orgId`: Organization UUID (set after login)
- `userId`: User UUID
- `productId`: Product UUID
- `priceId`: Price UUID
- `uploadId`: Upload job UUID
- `workflowId`: Workflow UUID
- `roleId`: Role UUID
- `permissionId`: Permission UUID
- `countryId`: Country UUID
- `stateId`: State UUID
- `zoneId`: Zone UUID
- `regionId`: Region UUID
- `depotId`: Depot UUID
- `categoryId`: Category UUID
- `brandId`: Brand UUID
- `attributeId`: Attribute UUID
- `documentId`: Document UUID
- `bundleId`: Bundle UUID
- `substitutionId`: Substitution UUID
- `hsnId`: HSN code UUID
- `gstSlabId`: GST slab UUID
- `productTaxId`: Product tax UUID
